name: Chana Pulao
summary: Basmati-style rice cooked with chickpeas, peas, and whole spices in broth, served with a quick yogurt raita.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs mostly clear.
Heat the oil in a pot with a tight lid over medium heat. Add the bay leaves, cinnamon, and cumin for 20 seconds, then the onion. Cook 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, and turmeric for 1 minute. Add the rice and stir 1 minute to coat it in the oil.
Add the chickpeas, peas, broth, and 0.5 tsp salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes. Don't lift the lid.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat, then sprinkle with garam masala and fluff with a fork. Stir a pinch of salt and cumin into the yogurt and serve it on the side.

glutenFree.notes: Rice, chickpeas, yogurt, and spices are naturally gluten-free. Check the broth and garam masala labels.

budgetNotes: Substitution: plain long-grain white rice replaces basmati, which costs about twice as much. The taste changes: basmati is more fragrant and its grains stay longer and fluffier. Long-grain rice tastes plainer and is a little stickier. Rinsing it well helps. Use basmati if you have it, with the same water.
Skip the yogurt and use vegetable broth to make it vegan, at about $7.75 total.
Rinsing the rice is what keeps the grains separate instead of mushy.
Good with a fried egg on top for extra protein, about $0.33 a person.
